in_hebrew.name: Micheline
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Maiden, little one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Micheline הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the ancient Greek 'mikhe' meaning 'moon' and 'linos' meaning 'young one' or 'maiden'. In Christian tradition, Micheline represents the divine feminine and the maternal love of God.

in_greek.name: Micheline
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Maiden, little one
in_greek.long_meaning: Micheline είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the ancient Greek 'mikhe' meaning 'moon' and 'linos' meaning 'young one' or 'maiden'. In Christian tradition, Micheline represents the divine feminine and the maternal love of God.

in_latin.name: Micheline
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Maiden, little one
in_latin.long_meaning: Micheline est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana.
